title: Local bootstrap reliability
content:
Local bootstrap reliability Normal bootstrap path npm install
cd nemoclaw && npm install && npm run build
cd
npm run verify:core
Restricted-environment fallback If lifecycle scripts fail because the environment cannot reach required registries or blocks install hooks, use this local-only fallback: npm install --ignore-scripts
cd nemoclaw && npm install --ignore-scripts
cd
node scripts/verify-core.js
npm install --ignore-scripts is for contributor-side diagnosis only. Do not use it for release packaging, publish flows, or CI baselines because it skips lifecycle behavior that release artifacts depend on. Interpreting fallback results PASS means the targeted check ran and succeeded. WARN means a required toolchain/dependency was missing in the local environment. FAIL means the repository check executed and failed. Use node scripts/verify-core.js --strict when you need local behavior equivalent to CI failure semantics
